Write176 main slope bytes backward from the reverse anchor.

Use the generated byte heights for sloped top collision.

Move Player1 horizontally by the signed fixed-point surface drift.
Check hazard contact for a secondary rider with its original exemptions.
Move Player2 horizontally by the saved surface displacement.
Return after flat/sloped hazard collision and optional rider effects.
